verdict.rationale: Keycloak ships an official Admin CLI, kcadm.sh, packaged in the server distribution's bin directory, which supports scripted administration of realms, users, roles, and clients. A server-side update compatibility command also exists. missing for 10: in-depth CLI reference (command coverage, output formats such as JSON for agent consumption, non-interactive auth details), any AI/agent-oriented CLI features, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: packages the Admin CLI server distribution with the execution scripts in the bin directory. The Linux script is called kcadm.sh
Execute the update compatibility command to check if Keycloak supports a rolling update for a change in your deployment.
